  • Berufserfahrung passend zu deiner Karrierestufe, von ersten praktischen Erfahrungen (Junior) über mehrjährige Buchhaltungspraxis bis hin zu 3 bis 5+ Jahren und fundierter Bilanzbuchhaltungserfahrung (Senior/Bilanzbuchhalter)
  • Idealerweise (für erfahrene Profile) Praxis aus einer Steuerkanzlei/einem Steuerbüro sowie Beteiligung an oder eigenständige Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Kenntnisse in HGB und Finanzbuchhaltung, je nach Level Grundkenntnisse oder umfassende Expertise
  • Begeisterung für digitale Innovationen und Erfahrung bzw. Offenheit im Umgang mit digitalen Workflows
  • Kenntnisse in Microsoft M365 und DATEV (Grundkenntnisse wünschenswert bis sicherer Umgang); Erfahrung mit Business Central, Oracle oder branchenspezifischen ERP-Systemen von Vorteil
  • Ausgeprägtes Zahlenverständnis, Sorgfalt und Genauigkeit
  • Eine selbstständige, lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise sowie Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit, digital wie persönlich
  • Von Vorteil (kein Muss): ein eigenes Mandanten-Netzwerk, das du mit einbringen möchtest

Was wir dir bieten

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Bring deine Ideen ein und gestalte aktiv die Zukunft der Buchhaltung mit
  • Verantwortung & Entwicklung: Baue unser Team in Düsseldorf mit auf, mit echtem Raum für deine persönliche und fachliche Weiterentwicklung
  • Kontinuierliche Weiterbildung: Bleib am Puls der digitalen Entwicklung, insbesondere bei Workflows und Automatisierung
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote oder im modernen Büro mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen in der Düsseldorfer Altstadt, du hast die Wahl
  • Work-Life-Balance: 30 Urlaubstage, zusätzlich frei an Heiligabend und Silvester sowie flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Mitarbeiter-Benefits: spendit-Karte, kostenlose Getränke, regelmäßige Teamevents (in Planung)
  • Mobilität: Fahrtkostenzuschuss für das Deutschlandticket und JobRad-Leasing

Über uns

Die advacc advanced accounting GmbH ist der Partner für moderne, vollständig digitale Buchhaltung mit Standorten in Düsseldorf und Greifswald. Als externe Buchhaltung übernehmen wir für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden zentrale Aufgaben der Finanzbuchhaltung, von der Bearbeitung von Ein- und Ausgangsrechnungen über die Buchung aller Geschäftsvorfälle bis zur Lohnabrechnung und stellen fristgerechte, transparente und rechtssichere Abläufe sicher.
Darüber hinaus beraten wir betriebswirtschaftlich, steuern das Forderungsmanagement und treiben die Digitalisierung sowie Optimierung von Buchhaltungsprozessen voran. Unser erfahrenes Team arbeitet softwareunabhängig, schnell und proaktiv, mit dem Anspruch, Abläufe zu vereinfachen, Liquidität zu sichern und Freiräume für das Kerngeschäft unserer Kundinnen und Kunden zu schaffen. Wir stehen für innovative Lösungen, hohe Serviceorientierung und echte Hands-on-Mentalität.

title: Digitale Lohnbuchhaltung (w/m/d)
description: SKALAR – Wir bauen die Steuerkanzlei der Zukunft Radikal einfach. Voll digital. 100% mandantenfokussiert. Wir denken Steuerberatung komplett neu: einfacher, schneller und transparenter für Mandanten und Kanzleiteam zugleich. Wo andere Kanzleien mit manuellen Prozessen, langen Wartezeiten und intransparenter Kommunikation kämpfen, bauen wir ein völlig neues Erlebnis - digital, proaktiv, KI-gestützt. Mit automatisierten Prozessen im Hintergrund und digitalen Schnittstellen zum Mandanten laufen repetitive Aufgaben weitgehend von selbst - damit du Zeit hast für das, was wirklich zählt: anspruchsvolle Beratung, Sonderfälle und strategische Mandantenfragen. Der Unterschied zu anderen "Digitalkanzleien": Über die Hälfte unseres Teams sind Softwareentwickler. Du gestaltest direkt mit, was sie bauen - und damit, wie KI-gestützte Steuerberatung in dieser Branche überhaupt aussehen wird. Dein Steuerwissen prägt das Produkt, nicht nur dessen Anwendung. Wir sind ein erfahrenes Gründerteam aus Steuerberatern, Digital-Unternehmern und Softwareentwicklern mit einem Exit-Track-Record von 140 Mio. €. Mit dir gemeinsam möchten wir eine der führenden Kanzleien Deutschlands aufbauen. Aufgaben Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung: Du verantwortest die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung deiner Mandanten in DATEV Lohn und Gehalt – unterstützt durch KI- und Automatisierungstools, die Routine minimieren und Tiefe ermöglichen. Meldewesen & Compliance: SV-Meldungen, Lohnsteueranmeldungen, Beitragsnachweise, Bescheinigungswesen sowie die Kommunikation mit Finanzämtern, Krankenkassen und Behörden – termingerecht und prüfungssicher. Mandantenbetreuung: Du richtest neue Mandanten ein, begleitest sie langfristig und bist erste/r Ansprechpartner/in für lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtliche Fragen. Sonderfälle & Beratung: Bearbeitung komplexer Sachverhalte – von betrieblicher Altersvorsorge über Sachbezüge und Pfändungen bis zu Kurzarbeit und neuen regulatorischen Anforderungen (z. B. Mindestlohn, korrekte Lohnsteuerberechnung). Entwicklung neuer Beratungsleistungen: Du bestimmst mit, welche KI-gestützten Leistungen wir rund um Lohn und Personal entwickeln. Dein Lohn-Wissen + die Unterstützung durch unsere Softwareentwickler = Services, die klassische Kanzleien nicht anbieten können. Prozess- & Qualitätssicherung: Du gestaltest unsere Lohnprozesse aktiv mit – von der Mandanten-Schnittstelle über die Datenübernahme bis zur Lohnauswertung – und sorgst für gleichbleibend hohe Qualität. Qualifikationen Fachliche Basis: Abgeschlossene Ausbildung als Steuerfachangestellte/r, Lohnbuchhalter/in, Fachassistent/in Lohn und Gehalt oder vergleichbare Qualifikation. Lohn-Praxis: Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Entgeltabrechnung, sicher in Lohnsteuer- und Sozialversicherungsrecht. Sicherer Umgang mit DATEV LODAS oder Lohn und Gehalt. Mandantenkompetenz: Empathische und klare Kommunikation mit Mandanten und deren Mitarbeitenden – auch bei komplexeren Themen. Sorgfalt & Termintreue: Der Lohn muss stimmen. Du arbeitest präzise, strukturiert und zuverlässig – auch unter Druck. Unternehmerisches Mindset: Du willst direkt mitgestalten, wie KI-gestützte Lohnbuchhaltung aussieht – und mit Softwareentwicklern bauen, was es so noch nicht gibt. Tech-Begeisterung: Du probierst neue Lösungen aktiv aus und siehst Technologie als Hebel – nicht als Bedrohung. Benefits 🧠 Du baust mit, was Steuerberatung morgen ist - KI-gestützte Beratungsformate, die es so noch nicht gibt. Du entscheidest mit, wie Top-Beratung in der Zukunft aussieht 🤝 Steile Lernkurve mit Gründern und Tech-Team - Direkte Zusammenarbeit im Alltag, gegenseitiges Sparring auf Augenhöhe 🚀 Volle Verantwortung ab Tag 1 - Eigene Mandate, Leistungsportfolio, Wachstumsstrategie - du gestaltest mit 🛠️ Modernes Tech-Setup — Digitale Prozesse, KI-gestützte Tools, klare Strukturen 💰 Kompetitives Gehaltspaket 🏠 Hybrides Arbeiten - Homeoffice und Büro flexibel kombinieren 📍 Büro im Herzen Münchens , top angebunden 🎁 3.000 € p.a. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst.   • Breite Kenntnisse in operativer und konzeptioneller Personalarbeit sowie gute Kenntnisse im Arbeits- und Betriebsverfassungsrecht
  • Erfahrung in der vertrauensvollen Zusammenarbeit mit Betriebsräten

Unser Angebot

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge sowie weitere standortabhängige Sozialleistungen
  • Weiterbildungs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Mitarbeiterrabatte, Fahrrad-Leasing und vergünstigte Fitness- und Gesundheitsangebote
  • Kollegiales Umfeld, kurze Entscheidungswege und Unterstützung durch erfahrene Teams

Interesse?

raw.title: Working Student (m/w/d) - Cyber Security Engineering
raw.description:
As a leading global software product company in Compliance & Automation, IMTF Group develops innovative RegTech solutions focusing on Anti-Money Laundering, Know Your Customer, and Anti-Fraud. Our technology helps financial institutions fight financial crime and meet demanding regulatory requirements.

At IMTF, we value innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning. We encourage our teams to explore new technologies, challenge existing approaches, and continuously improve how we develop and deliver secure software.

As a Working Student in Cyber Security Engineering, you will join our Research & Development organization and help improve the security tools we develop and use internally. You will work on vulnerability scanners, security automation, and supporting software that helps us identify, assess, and address security risks across our products.

This is a hands-on software engineering role where you can apply your academic knowledge to real-world security challenges.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and enhance our internal security tools, including vulnerability scanners and automated security checks
  • Improve vulnerability detection, analysis, and reporting to deliver accurate and actionable security findings
  • Help automate security assessments of applications, dependencies, containers, and infrastructure
  • Contribute to tools and processes for software supply chain security, including SBOM and vulnerability management
  • Research emerging vulnerabilities, attack techniques, and security technologies and evaluate their relevance to our software
  • Integrate security tools and automated checks into our development and CI/CD workflows
  • Collaborate with software engineers to improve the effectiveness and reliability of our security tooling
  • Explore opportunities to leverage AI and automation to make security analysis more efficient

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Cyber Security, IT Security, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field
  • Basic programming skills, preferably in Python, and an interest in developing real-world software
  • Foundational understanding of IT security, networking, operating systems, and common software vulnerabilities
  • Interest in vulnerability assessment, penetration testing, and DevSecOps practices
  • Familiarity with Linux, Git, or container technologies is an advantage
  • Curiosity about security tools, automation, and emerging technologies
  • Analytical thinking, strong problem-solving skills, and a hands-on approach
  • Interest in using modern AI-assisted development tools
  • Ability to work independently while actively collaborating with a development team
  • Good communication skills in English; German language skills are an advantage

Previous professional experience in Cyber Security is not required. We value curiosity, practical problem-solving skills, and a willingness to learn.

Benefits

  • Make the World Safer: Help us strengthen the security of software used to combat financial crime
  • Be Part of an Established RegTech: Gain practical experience at an international Swiss software company
  • Hands-on Engineering: Work on real security software and contribute improvements that make a measurable difference
  • Ownership and Development: Take responsibility for your work, learn from experienced engineers, and develop your technical skills
  • Paid Further Education: Benefit from opportunities to expand your knowledge and professional capabilities
  • International Exposure: Collaborate with colleagues across different countries and engineering disciplines

The anticipated salary for this Working Student - Cyber Engineering position in Germany is EUR 18,000 gross per year, based on a 20-hour working week (50% employment level).

At IMTF, we are committed to treating all candidates with respect and equality, regardless of gender, religion, nationality, or any other characteristic. We embrace diversity and inclusion as integral parts of our organizational culture and welcome candidates from all backgrounds.

title: Anthropic Research Resident
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><strong>About Anthropic</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.</p></div><h2><strong>About the role</strong></h2> <p>The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a <strong>professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer</strong> and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required.</p> <h2><strong>What to expect</strong></h2> <ul> <li>A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers</li> <li>Access to Claude models and GPU compute</li> <li>Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Interview process</strong></h2> <p>The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check.</p> <p>Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027.</p> <h2><strong>You may be a good fit if you</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole</li> <li>Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full-time</li> <li>Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer)</li> <li>Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments</li> <li>Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Strong candidates may also</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety</li> <li>Have experience with LLMs, reinforcement learning or Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Mentors and research areas</strong></h2> <p>Potential Anthropic mentors include:</p> <ul> <li><a href="https://www.linkedin.com/in/sara-price-310757b2/">Sara Price</a>: leads the Alignment Training team; background in data science</li> <li><a href="https://ethanperez.net/">Ethan Perez</a>: leads the Alignment Science team; background in machine learning</li> <li><a href="https://evhub.github.io/">Evan Hubinger</a>: leads the Alignment Stress-Testing team; formerly at The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI)</li> <li><a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=fW7yK10AAAAJ&amp;hl=en">Samuel Marks</a>: leads the Scalable Oversight team; background in mathematics</li> <li><a href="https://elanapearl.github.io/">Elana Simon</a>: researches the interpretability of language models and biological models; background in biomedical informatics</li> <li><a href="https://belindal.github.io/">Belinda Li</a>: researches how language models represent the world, users, and themselves; background in natural language processing (PhD, MIT)</li> <li><a href="https://jlindsey15.github.io/">Jack Lindsey</a>: leads the Model Psychology team; background in theoretical neuroscience</li> <li><a href="https://nicholas.carlini.com/">Nicholas Carlini</a>: researches adversarial machine learning and AI security; previously at DeepMind and Google Brain</li> <li><a href="https://sohldickstein.com/">Jascha Sohl-Dickstein</a>: works at the intersection of safety and pretraining; background in physics and neuroscience, formerly Principal Scientist at Google Brain</li> </ul> <p>Residents will work on empirical research questions in collaboration with Anthropic's research teams. Areas we are particularly interested in include:</p> <p>AI safety &amp; alignment</p> <ul> <li>Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains.</li> <li>Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.</li> <li>Model Organisms: Creating <a href="https://www.lesswrong.com/posts/ChDH335ckdvpxXaXX/model-organisms-of-misalignment-the-case-for-a-new-pillar-of-1">model organisms of misalignment</a> to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise.</li> <li>Model Internals and Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures.</li> <li>Safeguards Research: Developing robust defenses against adversarial attacks, comprehensive evaluation frameworks for model safety, and automated systems to detect and mitigate potential risks before deployment.</li> <li>AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations.</li> </ul> <p>AI security &amp; frontier red-teaming</p> <ul> <li>Stress-testing frontier models to understand the full extent of their current capabilities in fields such as cybersecurity, robotics or cryptography.</li> </ul> <p>ML systems &amp; reinforcement learning</p> <ul> <li>Improving how frontier models are trained and building the infrastructure behind that research, from model architecture, optimizers and training data to accelerator simulators, hardware backends and RL environment pipelines.</li> </ul> <p>For a fuller picture of the questions we care about, see our <a href="https://alignment.anthropic.com/2025/recommended-directions/">Recommendations for Technical AI Safety Research Directions</a> and recent publications from our <a href="https://alignment.anthropic.com/">Alignment</a>, <a href="https://transformer-circuits.pub/">Interpretability</a> and <a href="https://red.anthropic.com/">Frontier Red</a> teams.</p> <h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Duration:</strong> Placements are six weeks, three months or six months, depending on team fit and candidate preferences. Other lengths between three and six months are possible by exception.</li> <li><strong>Location:</strong> This application is for a remote UK position, with the option to work from our London office. However, we prefer that Residents work from our San Francisco office, where most of our research staff is based, but remote participation is possible, especially for shorter placements. Most full-time research roles at Anthropic require relocation to San Francisco. Remote participants need to be based in a country where Anthropic can hire.</li> <li><strong>Commitment:</strong> Full-time role for the duration of the residency.</li> <li><strong>Compensation:</strong> £265,000 to £375,000/year pro-rated for the duration of the residency + benefits</li> <li><strong>Visa sponsorship:</strong> We sponsor visas for placements of three months or longer. For six-week placements we encourage remote participation from a country where Anthropic can hire.</li> </ul> <p>Applicants may also be considered for the <a href="https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/anthropic/jobs/5183044008">Anthropic Fellows Program</a>.</p><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="description"><p>The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.&nbsp;</p> <p>For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.</p></div><div class="title">Annual Salary:</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£265,000</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£375,000 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><h2><strong>Logistics</strong></h2> <p><strong>Minimum education: </strong>Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience</p> <p><strong>Required field of study:&nbsp;</strong>A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience</p> <p><strong>Minimum years of experience: </strong>Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position</p> <p><strong>Location-based hybrid policy:</strong> Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.</p> <p><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Visa sponsorship:</strong>&nbsp;We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.</p> <p><strong>We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.</strong> Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed.&nbsp; Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.<br><br><strong data-stringify-type="bold">Your safety matters to us.</strong> To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you ----- addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit&nbsp;<u data-stringify-type="underline"><a class="c-link c-link--underline" href="http://anthropic.com/careers" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="http://anthropic.com/careers" data-sk="tooltip_parent" data-remove-tab-index="true">anthropic.com/careers</a></u>&nbsp;directly for confirmed position openings.</p> <h2><strong>How we're different</strong></h2> <p>We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.</p> <p>The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI &amp; Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.</p> <h2><strong>Come work with us!</strong></h2> <p>Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. <strong data-stringify-type="bold">Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:</strong>&nbsp;Learn about&nbsp;<a class="c-link" href="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" target="_blank" data-stringify-link="https://www.anthropic.com/candidate-ai-guidance" data-sk="tooltip_parent">our policy</a> for using AI in our application process.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>About Us</h3> <p class="p1">With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.</p> <p class="p1">Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.</p> <p class="p1">At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.</p> <p class="p1">Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.</p></div><h3>Reports To</h3> <p>Director, Solutions Engineering</p> <h3>What You Will Be Doing</h3> <p>In this role, you&nbsp;will be responsible for all technical aspects of pre-sale customer engagement including actively driving and managing technology evaluations, working as a key advisor and advocate for our products and solutions, engaging with customers virtually or in person, performing engineering site or architecture assessments, and developing recommendations to assist customers with deployment of electric vehicle charging solutions infrastructure. You will also be responsible for developing RFP/Tender responses and providing training on our products.&nbsp;Key focus areas also encompasses electric vehicle supply equipment (EVSE), infrastructure, and the operational needs of light, medium and heavy duty fleets, including vehicle,&nbsp;&nbsp;energy management and battery storage solutions that consider the charging capabilities, dwell time, routing and scheduling of the vehicles, and integrations with 3<sup>rd</sup> party platforms.&nbsp;</p> <p>The applicant must be a critical thinker, self-motivated and able to effectively manage their time.&nbsp;</p> <p>Travel requirement: up to 50% travel across Europe, predominantly within the UK and Ireland.</p> <h3>What You Will Bring to ChargePoint</h3> <ul> <li>Maintain deep technical and business knowledge of electric vehicle and fleet directions and trends, and how to effectively integrate electric vehicles and charging infrastructure into fleet operations.</li> <li>Develop and deliver presentations to partners and customers in support of the sales process, educating potential customers on the benefits of ChargePoint solutions.</li> <li>Act as a technical consultant, learning and understanding customer needs and developing the right solutions; working with product management to help align product development with customer and market needs.</li> <li>Maintain deep technical and business knowledge of market and industry trends, and how to effectively integrate electric vehicles and charging infrastructure into client business operations.</li> <li>Responsible for identifying technical issues that may affect customer satisfaction and proactively work to resolve such issues.</li> <li>Provide both general “best practice” and customer-specific engineering recommendations for ChargePoint software feature usage, API implementations and integrations with external systems.</li> <li>Maintain knowledge of local electrical installation codes and relevant standards, specifically related to Electric Vehicle Supply Equipment (EVSE) and energy management solutions.</li> <li>Respond to functional and technical elements of RFPs/Tenders; assist in the development and execution of SoWs (statements of work) and other proposals.</li> <li>Responsible for identifying technical issues that may affect customer satisfaction and proactively work to solve such issues.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Requirements<br><br></strong></h3> <ul> <li>Bachelor or Masters degree in Engineering, Mathematics, Computer Science, or equivalent</li> <li>Minimum 8 years of combined experience in technical sales or technical consulting</li> <li>Experience should include some: electrical engineering, telecommunications, information technology, software development, technical writing</li> <li>Excellent presentation, oral and written communication skills</li> <li>Strong customer facing and relationship building skill</li> <li>Excellent written and oral language skills&nbsp;</li> <li>Fleet vehicle operations, High Power solutions, Battery Energy Storage&nbsp;or large facility experience desired.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h3>&nbsp;</h3> <h3><strong>Location</strong></h3> <p>UK- Remote</p> <p>&nbsp;</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p>We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. description: <div class="flex max-w-full flex-col grow"> <div class="min-h-8 text-message relative flex w-full flex-col items-end gap-2 text-start break-words whitespace-normal [.text-message+&amp;]:mt-1" data-message-author-role="assistant" data-message-id="f299b106-f5ab-4bce-90c8-cf18e84f4803" data-message-model-slug="gpt-5-2-thinking"> <div class="flex w-full flex-col gap-1 empty:hidden first:pt-[1px]"> <div class="markdown prose dark:prose-invert w-full break-words dark markdown-new-styling"> <h2 style="text-align: center;"><em><strong>Web / Front End Developer - Research Participants - United Kingdom</strong></em></h2> <h3 style="text-align: center;" data-start="26" data-end="43">&nbsp;</h3> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="26" data-end="43">&nbsp;</h4> <p data-start="45" data-end="169"><em><strong>Location:</strong> </em>Remote (UK)<br><em><strong>Type of contract:</strong> </em>Freelance<br><em><strong>Hourly Rate:</strong> </em>£19 (pay based on actual study time)</p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="26" data-end="43"><em>About Prolific</em></h4> <p data-start="45" data-end="169">Prolific is not just another player in the AI space – we are building the biggest pool of quality human data in the world.</p> <p data-start="171" data-end="344">Over 35,000 AI developers, researchers, and organizations use Prolific to gather data from paid study participants with a wide variety of experiences, knowledge, and skills.</p> <p><em><strong>The Role</strong></em><strong><br></strong>Do you have a device with a microphone? Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting web and front end developers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a web or front end developer. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.</p> <p>The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.</p> <p><em><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant</li> <li>Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences</li> <li>Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective</li> <li>Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Residence in the UK</li> <li>Fluent English</li> <li>A device with a working microphone</li> <li>No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Why join this project?</strong></em><strong><br></strong>This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.</p> <p><em>Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.</em></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="2302" data-end="2362"><em>Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant</em></h4> <p data-start="2364" data-end="2679">Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.</p> <p data-start="2681" data-end="2975">We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.</p> <p data-start="2977" data-end="3349">We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.</p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3351" data-end="3391"><em>Links to more information on Prolific</em></h4> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3393" data-end="3402"><a href="https://www.prolific.com/">Website</a></p> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3404" data-end="3413"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@JoinProlific">Youtube</a></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3415" data-end="3435"><em>Privacy Statement</em></h4> <p data-start="3437" data-end="3863" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/Policy-Privacy-Notice-for-Candidates-f94a136a67544388b4888bc436451b57">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

Get paid to take part in voice interviews. We’re inviting UX researchers based in the UK to take part in a research study run by an institution focused on global policy change. This is a paid research participation opportunity, not a job as a UX researcher. Quick signup, flexible schedule, real payouts.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your voice can help build a picture of how people across the UK think and talk about important issues, and that evidence is designed to inform real policy decisions. Every participant counts, and together we’re working toward a shared research goal.</p> <p>The project launches in about one week, and places are allocated on a first come, first served basis, so please sign up as soon as you can.</p> <p><em><strong>What you’ll be doing</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Taking part in a short voice conversation with another participant</li> <li>Completing a short online survey sharing your views and experiences</li> <li>Giving honest, considered responses based on your own perspective</li> <li>Watching the community research goal progress as more participants take part</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>What you’ll bring</strong></em></p> <ul> <li>Residence in the UK</li> <li>Fluent English</li> <li>A device with a working microphone</li> <li>No research experience or specialist research qualifications required. We want a genuine cross-section of the UK population.</li> </ul> <p><em><strong>Why join this project?</strong></em><strong><br></strong>This is a chance to be part of something meaningful and have a say in research aimed at shaping policy. Once the findings are published, we’ll share them with participants so you can see the impact of your contribution.</p> <p><em>Please note that you must be new to Prolific to sign up successfully. If you already have a Prolific account, there is no need to register again. Simply ensure your profile is up to date to be eligible for this and future opportunities.</em></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="2302" data-end="2362"><em>Why Prolific is a great platform to join as a Participant</em></h4> <p data-start="2364" data-end="2679">Joining our platform as a Prolific participant will give you the chance to influence the AI models of the future using your professional expertise. Once you pass our assessment, you can join Prolific in just 15 minutes, and start enjoying competitive pay rates, flexible hours, and the ability to work from home.</p> <p data-start="2681" data-end="2975">We've built a unique platform that connects researchers and companies with a global pool of participants, enabling the collection of high-quality, ethically sourced human behavioural data and feedback. This data is the cornerstone of developing more accurate, nuanced, and aligned AI systems.</p> <p data-start="2977" data-end="3349">We believe that the next leap in AI capabilities won't come solely from scaling existing models, but from integrating diverse human perspectives and behaviours into AI development. By providing this crucial human data infrastructure, Prolific is positioning itself at the forefront of the next wave of AI innovation – one that reflects the breadth and the best of humanity.</p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3351" data-end="3391"><em>Links to more information on Prolific</em></h4> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3393" data-end="3402"><a href="https://www.prolific.com/">Website</a></p> <p style="text-align: center;" data-start="3404" data-end="3413"><a href="https://www.youtube.com/@JoinProlific">Youtube</a></p> <h4 style="text-align: center;" data-start="3415" data-end="3435"><em>Privacy Statement</em></h4> <p data-start="3437" data-end="3863" data-is-last-node="" data-is-only-node="">By submitting your application, you agree that Prolific may collect your personal data for recruiting and global organisation planning. Prolific's&nbsp;<a href="https://www.notion.so/prolific/Policy-Privacy-Notice-for-Candidates-f94a136a67544388b4888bc436451b57">Candidate Privacy Notice</a>&nbsp;explains what personal information Prolific may process, where Prolific may process your personal information, its purposes for processing your personal information, and the rights you can exercise over Prolific use of your personal personal information.</p> </div> </div> </div> </div> <p>&nbsp;</p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Product Manager, Pricing
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><p>We're looking for a Product Manager to own Pricing within our Growth team across Deliveroo and Wolt! This role operates across 40+ markets in EMEA, and sits at the heart of our marketplace: Our fee strategy directly shapes consumer conversion, order frequency, PnL outcomes - and connects deeply to rider earnings and merchant economics across the Globe. You'll be responsible for building a pricing strategy and experimentation roadmap that grows revenue and profitability sustainably, without compromising the customer experience.</p> <p>This is a very high-visibility role. You'll partner closely with Leadership, Data Science, Engineering, Finance, Marketing, and Operations to design, launch, and iterate on pricing experiments across all markets, from delivery fee and service fee algorithms to 0-1 new ventures. You'll be expected to build a strong testing culture, translate ambiguous commercial questions into a rigorous experimentation agenda, and communicate results and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>Our ambition is simple: make our platform an affordable, daily habit for all users.</p> <p>The Pricing team builds the systems and experiences that touch every single order — from delivery options to promotions, fees, and entirely new pricing models. Operating across 40+ markets, our work sits at the intersection of customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.</p> <p>Small changes at this scale can change how customers perceive us, how often they order, and the economics of the entire marketplace. We bring together consumer psychology, experimentation, data science, economics, and product craft to answer one deceptively difficult question: <strong>How do we make every order feel like great value while driving sustainable growth?</strong></p> <h2><strong>What You’ll Do</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Own the end-to-end strategy and roadmap for a portfolio of global pricing products.</li> <li>Identify and launch major growth opportunities across affordability, conversion, frequency, revenue, and profitability.</li> <li>Drive 0 to 1 big bets through validation, launch, then scale them 100X.</li> <li>Partner deeply with Data Science and ML Engineering to design pricing algorithms, experiments, and scalable platform capabilities.</li> <li>Develop hypotheses, launch experiments, interpret results, and turn learnings into product strategy.</li> <li>Define the metrics and decision frameworks used to evaluate customer value, growth, and marketplace economics.</li> <li>Communicate strategy, results, and tradeoffs to senior leaders across DoorDash.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What We’re Looking For</strong></h2> <p>You might be a great fit if you:</p> <ul> <li>Have significant product management experience building complex consumer, marketplace, growth, or monetization products.</li> <li>Are deeply analytical and comfortable using experimentation and data to make high-stakes product decisions.</li> <li>Are comfortable working closely with Data Science and ML Engineering on algorithmic or optimization problems.</li> <li>Can turn ambiguous commercial questions into clear and executable product hypotheses and roadmaps.</li> <li>Can operate as a “conductor” — aligning technical, operational, and business stakeholders and stitching together strategy, execution, and influence across teams.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Why Join Us?</strong></h2> <p>At Deliveroo and Wolt, you’ll do work that matters, solving real-world problems in a three-sided marketplace that’s constantly evolving.</p> <p>We’re food lovers, problem solvers, community builders and more, brought together by a shared drive to make things better. Working here you can expect to:</p> <p>🔧 Solve meaningful problems at real scale Work on a complex, always-on marketplace that impacts millions every day.</p> <p>🌱 See your impact, fast Ship, test and improve ideas quickly in a low-hierarchy, high-ownership environment.</p> <p>🧠 Grow through challenge and ownership Take on big, ambiguous problems and accelerate your career with strong support.</p> <p>🌎 A culture built for builders High standards, collaboration, flexible working and continuous learning.</p> <p>💰 Share in the success you help create Competitive salary and equity options, so you’re rewarded for the impact you make.</p> <p>➡️ Want a deeper look at how we build? Check out our<a href="https://deliveroo.engineering/"> Tech Blog</a>.</p> <p>We aim to create a fair process that lets your skills shine—our interview typically includes 3-4 stages. Find more about how we hire<a href="https://careers.deliveroo.co.uk/how-we-hire/"> here</a>.</p> <h2><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></h2> <p>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Diversity, Equity and Inclusion</strong><br><br>At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. title: Engineering Manager - Cx App Foundations
description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Our Global Structure</strong></p> <p><br>Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.</p></div><h2>About the Team</h2> <p>Cx App Foundations is a platform organisation within our global Cx organisation. It provides shared consumer foundations and platform capabilities used by engineering teams across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo. Within this organisation, the Velocity team owns the paved road for consumer app development across mobile and web: shared SDKs and client foundations, integration patterns and multi-brand customisation, migration playbooks and reference implementations, and developer tooling that makes building on shared foundations fast and safe. Our mission is to reduce the cost, time, and risk of building consumer experiences across platforms and brands. Product teams own customer-facing experiences; our job is to make sure they can spend their time on delivering delightful experiences. The team is AI-native: AI is a default part of how we design, build, and ship software.<br><br></p> <h2>About the Role</h2> <p>As the Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of experienced engineers across mobile and web, collaborating closely with product teams, design, and adjacent platform organisations across three brands. Your primary responsibility will be owning the team's roadmap and delivery of shared client foundations, and driving their adoption across the organisation, so that product teams ship delightful customer experiences without rebuilding the foundations under them. You will be a key player in keeping the team's operating model healthy: clear intake from stakeholders, predictable delivery, and support expectations that keep the platform from drifting into a general escalation queue. You will also guide architectural and system design decisions with your tech leads. You will stay hands-on: contributing code, reviews, and prototypes alongside the team is part of the job. This role is ideal for a leader who has run platforms, SDKs, or shared services for other engineering teams, communicates clearly across brands and time zones, and wants their impact measured through what other teams achieve with the foundations you ship.<br><br></p> <h2>You're excited about this opportunity because you will…</h2> <ul> <li>Own the platform roadmap - the shared SDKs, client foundations, and developer tooling the team ships - and sequence it against the migration and adoption goals of the three brands</li> <li>Drive adoption of the shared foundations by partnering with product teams, running onboarding and rollout support, and making the supported path the easiest path</li> <li>Lead, coach, and grow experienced mobile and web engineers, keeping growth conversations, calibration, and feedback loops running</li> <li>Keep the team's operating model healthy: clear intake (stakeholder management, shared-platform, product-specific, or exception work), supported capabilities with entry criteria and support expectations, and predictable delivery</li> <li>Guide architectural and system design decisions for client foundations that three brands and multiple app platforms depend on</li> <li>Stay hands-on by contributing code and reviews alongside the team, and champion AI-native development practices</li> <li>Grow the team through hiring</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Our humble expectations</h2> <ul> <li>You have 3+ years of experience managing engineers, including a team with senior engineers</li> <li>You have a solid background (5+ years) in mobile or web engineering, with enough technical depth to hold your own in architecture discussions about client foundations</li> <li>You use AI tooling fluently in your day-to-day work and stay close to the code</li> <li>You have run a platform, SDK, or shared service that other teams depend on, and know how to treat internal customers as customers</li> <li>You work across boundaries naturally: product teams, design, other platform organisations, data/analytics and stakeholders in other locations and time zones</li> <li>You hold a high bar for engineering quality and can navigate production incidents and release tradeoffs with calm structure</li> </ul> <h2>What we offer</h2> <p>A platform leadership role with real leverage: the foundations the team owns shape how consumer experiences get built across Wolt, DoorDash, and Deliveroo, and your roadmap decisions multiply across every product team that builds on them.<br><br></p> <h2><strong>Next steps</strong></h2> <p>The position will be raw.description:
What we're all about.

Do you ever have the urge to do things better than the last time? We do. And it’s this urge that drives us every day. Our environment of discovery and innovation means we’re able to create deep and valuable relationships with our clients to create real change for them and their industries. It’s what got us here – and it’s what will make our future. At Quantexa, you’ll experience autonomy and support in equal measures allowing you to form a career that matches your ambitions. 41% of our colleagues come from an ethnic or religious minority background. We speak over 20 languages across our 47 nationalities, creating a sense of belonging for all.

We're heading in one direction, the future. We’d love you to join us.

The opportunity.

The Quantexa Academy helps our customers, partners and colleagues become self-sufficient with the Quantexa Platform. We do that through online learning, instructor-led sessions and bespoke digital resources that let every user harness the power of our award-winning Decision Intelligence Platform.

As we continue to grow, we're looking for an Instructional Designer to join our Design & Publish Team within Education Services. You'll turn complex technical topics – data, analytics, software and FinTech – into clear, engaging and accessible learning experiences, taking projects from first conversation with a subject matter expert through to a polished, published solution.

This is a role for an independent problem solver. You'll own your design projects end to end, decide how best to approach each one, and organize your own time across several priorities at once, spotting risks early and keeping stakeholders informed without needing to be chased. You'll work alongside Product, R&D and Delivery experts, and have the room to bring your own ideas on tools, approaches and how we use AI to design better learning.

If you love making hard things easy to learn, and do your best work with autonomy and trust, we'd like to hear from you.

This is a hybrid role, with the expectation of attending the company office in central London twice a week.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and update technical learning solutions for customers, partners and employees, covering storyboards, articles, documentation, presentations, and eLearning.

  • Apply best practice in learning design methodologies, accessibility, and user experience, so every learner has a great experience.

  • Build assessments and use learner feedback and data to shape your design decisions.

  • Use AI-assisted tools to speed up research, authoring and quality checks, with human review to keep content accurate and aligned to learning objectives.

  • Work with subject matter experts, and with Product, Delivery and R&D teams, to understand the Platform and turn that knowledge into effective training.

  • Take ownership of your programs, keeping them current and aligned as the Platform evolves.

  • Research technical documentation, demos, recordings, and learner feedback to make sure our content is accurate and high quality.

  • Plan and track your own content projects, flagging risks and blockers early and keeping stakeholders in the loop.

  • Use tools such as Confluence, Jira, SharePoint and Asana to manage tasks, document your work and collaborate across teams.

  • Identify, propose and lead the introduction of new tools, processes or AI approaches that improve our learning design and the learner experience.

  • Support teammates through feedback and knowledge sharing, and take the lead on projects where it's useful.

What you'll bring.

Essential

  • Experience designing technical or complex training content – for example in FinTech, analytics, data science, data engineering or software development.

  • Solid knowledge of designing, delivering, and evaluating training programs grounded in adult learning principles and instructional design theories.

  • Good understanding of at least one programming language (Java, Scala, Python or any other OOP)

  • Strong written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex information clearly and concisely.

  • Confident use of Microsoft Office 365 (Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, SharePoint)

  • Experience, or real curiosity, in using GenAI for content creation, automation and productivity.

  • Strong organizational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt to changing needs.

  • A collaborative, proactive and solution-focused approach, and the ability to build positive relationships with colleagues and stakeholders.

Desirable

  • Experience with an LMS and using learner data or feedback to improve content.

  • Experience coordinating projects that involve several stakeholders.

  • Experience mentoring or sharing knowledge with colleagues, or an interest in doing so.

  • Familiarity with Confluence, Jira or Asana.

Our perks and quirks.

What makes you Q will help you to realize your full potential, flourish and enjoy what you do, while being recognized and rewarded with our broad range of benefits.

We offer:

  • Competitive salary & Company bonus

  • 25 days annual leave (with the option of buying up to 5 days, and rolling over up to 10), plus national holidays + your birthday off!

  • Pension scheme with a company contribution of 6% (when you contribute 3%)

  • Private Healthcare, including dental & optic cover

  • Life Insurance and Income Protection

  • Regularly bench-marked salary rates

  • Enhanced Maternity, Paternity, Adoption, or Shared Parental Leave

  • Well-being days

  • Volunteer Day off

  • Work from Home Equipment

  • Commuter, Tech and cycle to work schemes

  • Free Subscription to a meditation, relaxation and sleep app

  • Continuous Training and Development

  • Spend up to 2 months working outside of your country of employment over a rolling 12-month period with our ‘Work from Anywhere’ policy

  • Team Social Budget & Company-wide Socials

 

Our mission.

We have one mission. To help businesses grow. To make data easier. And to make the world a better place. We’re not a start-up. Not anymore. But we’ve not been around that long either. What we are is a collection of bright, passionate minds harnessing complexities and helping our clients and their communities. One culture, made of many. Heading in one direction – the future.

It’s all about you.

We want you to feel welcome, valued, and respected - because it’s your individuality and passion that make you Q. We see that, and we celebrate it. That’s why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Founding Account Executive (Italian Speaker)
description: About Sona Frontline work keeps the world running. Restaurants, hospitals, schools, nurseries, airlines, stores, emergency services. Together they employ 80% of the global workforce, over 3 billion people, and they're among the hardest businesses anywhere to run. By-the-minute scheduling, HR and payroll make them far more operationally complex than the average office, yet just 1% of venture funding has ever gone to software built for them. Rising costs, wage increases, labour shortages and tighter regulation have made fixing that urgent. Sona is the AI-native workforce management platform for frontline organisations, with agents that match staffing to real demand and take the admin load off managers. That's a $500bn+ market the software industry has mostly walked past. We've raised over $100M from N47, Felicis, Gradient and Northzone, signed more than 100 enterprise customers across the UK and US, and opened offices in London, New York, Austin and Lisbon. More on working at Sona here ( https://www.sona.ai/careers ). About the Role We're hiring a Founding Account Executive to win Sona's first customers in Italy and open the market for us. This is a senior, seller-first role, and you'll run every conversation with prospects in Italian, from the first call to the close. Our expansion into Europe is starting now and ramps up through 2027 across key markets. Italy is one of them, and you'll own the go-to-market launch there. Colleagues across Sona will be running the product, operations and other launch activities, so your focus is winning customers, building partnerships and creating the collateral to sell. With no sales team in market yet, you'll work with less support than a typical AE, and the team around you will grow as the market does. Day to day, you'll decide which Retail and Hospitality accounts to go after, from mid-market through to enterprise, and run consultative sales conversations yourself. You'll also build what a new market needs, including partnerships and Italian-language collateral. The platform is already localised for Italy, and you'll have product and solutions support. It's early, and the ground will shift as we learn what works. If you want a structured environment with lots of support around you, this won't be the right fit. If you want to shape how Sona sells in Italy from the start, it could be exactly that. The role is office-based in London, with travel to Italy as needed. Responsibilities Lead the go-to-market launch in Italy and win Sona's first customers, taking each deal from first conversation to close. Build your own pipeline across Retail and Hospitality, from mid-market to enterprise. Run strategic, consultative sales conversations in Italian. Build and run partnerships that open doors in the Italian market. Create the collateral Sona needs to sell in Italy. Work with Sona's Strategy and Expansion Lead on where to focus and how to approach the market. Feed what you learn from the market back to our Commercial and Product teams. Travel to Italy as the role requires. Requirements You're a native Italian speaker, comfortable selling and negotiating in Italian, with fluent English for working with colleagues in London. You have a senior Account Executive track record of winning new business, ideally across mid-market and enterprise deals. You have a founder mentality. You take ownership, make decisions with limited information, and are happy building without a playbook. You're strategic and consultative in how you sell, and you work well independently with less support than most AEs get. You're comfortable creating partnerships and collateral from scratch. You're based in London, or able to be, and happy to travel to Italy as the role needs. Strongly preferred: Spanish, French or German as an additional language. It doesn't replace Italian. Benefits Salary: £80,000 - £120,000 base depending on experience, with OTE of £160,000 - £240,000 Office-based in our London office, with travel to Italy as the role requires Share options 35 days annual leave (25 days standard plus 10 flexible public holiday days) Extra day of leave for every year of service Pension contributions matched up to 5% Comprehensive health insurance Enhanced parental leave & pay Salary sacrifice childcare scheme (Workplace Nursery) Annual all expenses paid team retreats The latest Macbook and equipment budget for your home office Professional development budget Unlimited free books Note: this represents a typical benefits package for a UK-based, full-time employee. Exact details may vary based on location and employment type but we try to be as fair as possible to all of our team members. Please ask your contact in the Talent team to clarify the available benefits for you. description: View our much better version of this job spec on our careers page: https://juro.notion.site/fao *** THE KEY BITS Location : We can currently only accept applications from candidates that are located and have long-term working rights in the UK. Flexibility : We have office hubs in London and Boston, as well as no-office hubs in several European countries. We operate a choice-first work approach that lets you work fully remotely from Day One even if you’re near an office hub. Salary : We benchmarked £45,000 + equity at IC2 in our progression framework for someone based in the UK. Let us know in your application if you like the look of the role but the salary doesn’t match what you’re looking for. Interviews : 2 stages totalling around 2.5 hours over 2 weeks, plus some prep for a task. Start date : As soon as you can start. Reporting to : Ryan, Interim Finance Director (while Eimear, Finance Director, is on leave) More info : The FAQ below, juro.com/careers , our handbook or ask ----- style="min-height:1.5em"> HELP US HELP THE WORLD AGREE FASTER Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it . Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity. Juro bills customers and pays suppliers across UK and US entities, and the volume keeps growing. We’re looking for someone who carries the day-to-day weight of finance operations together with the team. Roughly 60% of your week goes on AP/AR, and the rest is month-end and reporting support: reconciliations, revenue review, and pulling together what’s needed for statutory accounts, audit requests and VAT returns. You won’t be doing this alone: you’ll work closely with Charlotte, our Financial Controller, who owns the close, and Ryan, our Interim Finance Director (stepping in for Eimear), who leads the Finance function. Your mission is to: Own invoicing, payables and collections end-to-end so Juro gets paid efficiently, accurately and with strong control of cash, and support month-end so leadership can trust the numbers. Success looks like: Invoices done right first time: Contracts are turned into accurate invoices with minimal rework or back-and-forth with Sales and Customer Success. Money moving smoothly: Customers pay on time and suppliers are paid accurately across our UK and US entities. You keep an up-to-date view of what’s owed in and out, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) comes down over time. Reliable month-end support: Your reconciliations are accurate and on time, you flag escalations early, and you contribute to month-end, revenue review and statutory reporting. Solid, scalable ops: Processes are well controlled (from supplier onboarding and bank detail checks to payment run approvals), audit-ready, and increasingly automated inside Rillet (our ERP) and Ramp (our spend management system). You improve the process notes rather than just following them. We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub .     Juro has big ambitions: to make it incredibly easy for anyone to agree and manage legal contracts. And we'll need help doing it.

    Legal tech is on the rise, with Goldman Sachs estimating that 44% of legal tasks can be automated with generative AI. With the brand we have built and the agility of early stage we are well placed to capture this opportunity.

    Juro bills customers and pays suppliers across UK and US entities, and the volume keeps growing. We’re looking for someone who carries the day-to-day weight of finance operations together with the team.

    Roughly 60% of your week goes on AP/AR, and the rest is month-end and reporting support: reconciliations, revenue review, and pulling together what’s needed for statutory accounts, audit requests and VAT returns.

    You won’t be doing this alone: you’ll work closely with Charlotte, our Financial Controller, who owns the close, and Ryan, our Interim Finance Director (stepping in for Eimear), who leads the Finance function.

    Your mission is to:

    Own invoicing, payables and collections end-to-end so Juro gets paid efficiently, accurately and with strong control of cash, and support month-end so leadership can trust the numbers.

    Success looks like:

    1. Invoices done right first time: Contracts are turned into accurate invoices with minimal rework or back-and-forth with Sales and Customer Success.

    2. Money moving smoothly: Customers pay on time and suppliers are paid accurately across our UK and US entities. You keep an up-to-date view of what’s owed in and out, and Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) comes down over time.

    3. Reliable month-end support: Your reconciliations are accurate and on time, you flag escalations early, and you contribute to month-end, revenue review and statutory reporting.

    4. Solid, scalable ops: Processes are well controlled (from supplier onboarding and bank detail checks to payment run approvals), audit-ready, and increasingly automated inside Rillet (our ERP) and Ramp (our spend management system). You improve the process notes rather than just following them.

    We care about building a diverse team where everyone feels they belong. That’s why our perks & benefits and choice-first work approach are designed with inclusivity in mind. Read more in our diversity, inclusion & belonging hub.

So if you think you have what it takes but don't meet every single point above, please still get in touch. We'd love to have a chat and see if you could be a great fit.

    Curious how you’d fit? Try our personality quiz to see how you map against our principles.

    On top of that, you have been part of a journey where:

    • You’ve done both AR and AP: raising invoices, handling billing queries, chasing payments or paying suppliers.

    • You’ve been the #1 point of contact for customers or suppliers on billing and payments. You can be firm about an overdue balance without damaging the relationship, and you keep Sales, CS and budget holders in the loop.

    Bonus points if:

    • You’ve worked with SaaS contracts or subscription billing.

    • You’ve helped with VAT returns, US sales tax, revenue reporting or audit requests.

    • You’ve worked in a multi-entity (UK/US) business with multi-currency invoicing.

    This job likely isn’t for you if:

    • You’re mainly looking for formal accounting training or a pathway to becoming ACA-qualified.

    • You want to own the month-end close or focus on technical accounting, rather than a hands-on mix of finance operations and reporting support.

    • You prefer clearly defined, static processes and don’t enjoy owning messy, real-world problems and making them better (especially with AI).

raw.title: Software Engineer (Application Platform/Tech Lead)
raw.description:
About Us

At TrustFlight, we are proud to be a global leader in mission-critical software systems and technical services, trusted by aerospace and aviation industries worldwide. Our innovative solutions power the safety and efficiency of aviation operations, ensuring the safety of hundreds of thousands of passengers and crew every month.

Why Join TrustFlight

✈️ Our Mission: To revolutionize aviation by delivering digital workflow solutions that enhance safety, streamline operations, and inspire confidence across the industry.

🚀 Impact: Over 200,000 users rely on our systems every day for operational safety, compliance management, and mission-critical decision-making.

🚩 Core Values: Guided by integrity, responsibility, innovation, and excellence, we are committed to empowering our partners to operate with confidence.

Join us in shaping the future of aviation and making an impact through technology.

Your Role

As a Software Engineer – Application Platform, you’ll help build secure, scalable platform foundations, especially around identity, authentication, and core system design. Beyond your individual technical contributions, you’ll be expected to act as a strong engineering leader within the organization by helping shape technical direction, raising engineering standards, and influencing how teams approach complex platform challenges.

This is an opportunity to have an impact beyond the code you write. You’ll bring technical leadership to architectural discussions, help others navigate difficult engineering decisions, and lead by example through strong ownership, sound judgment, and a commitment to quality. You’ll build trust across teams by sharing knowledge, challenging assumptions constructively, and helping drive initiatives forward.

You bring strong fundamentals in authentication and security, with a clear understanding of sign-in flows, protocol choices, and how identity connects across the broader system. A disciplined testing mindset and solid cloud and deployment knowledge ensure your work is reliable, verifiable, and production-ready.

Success in this role comes from taking ownership, communicating early, sharing context, and documenting decisions clearly. You’ll help teams stay aligned, reduce friction across the platform, and contribute to a culture of engineering excellence across TrustFlight.

What you’ll be doing

Development & Code Quality:

  • Design and implement features and fixes using modular, low-disruption approaches that preserve system integrity and long-term maintainability

  • Reason about complex, real-world data models, including multi-tenant systems, maintaining a clear mental model of how data is structured, accessed, and evolved

  • Play an active role in architectural discussions, helping guide technical decisions based on system constraints, scalability, security, and future growth

  • Debug and resolve complex platform issues by working directly with raw data, services, and infrastructure layers

  • Uphold and help raise engineering standards through clean, maintainable code, thoughtful technical trade-offs, and strong engineering practices

  • Take ownership of complex technical challenges and help drive them from ambiguity through to implementation and delivery

  • Take ambiguous, high-stakes technical problems from first principles through to delivery

Testing & Quality Assurance:

  • Maintain a strong testing discipline, ensuring all changes are well-covered by appropriate unit, integration, and end-to-end tests

  • Advocate for and implement quality-first engineering practices, including test automation and early validation of platform changes

  • Lead by example in establishing a high bar for quality, reliability, and maintainability

  • Ensure reliability and confidence in releases by validating behavior across services, environments, and tenant boundaries

DevOps & Infrastructure:

  • Work confidently with cloud-based infrastructure and deployment practices, contributing to reliable, scalable platform operations

  • Collaborate on or support CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows to enable safe, repeatable releases

  • Apply strong foundational knowledge of authentication and security, understanding sign-in flows, protocol choices, and how identity integrates with the broader system

  • Help guide platform-level decisions around stability, observability, security, and operational excellence as systems evolve

  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, tooling, and platform capabilities across the organization

Leadership, Collaboration & Communication:

  • Be a trusted technical voice within the organization, providing leadership through expertise, ownership, sound judgment, and collaboration

  • Help shape technical direction and engineering practices, influencing decisions beyond your immediate area of responsibility

  • Lead by example, demonstrating strong engineering habits and helping create a culture of accountability, quality, and continuous improvement

  • Support and mentor other engineers through knowledge sharing, technical guidance, code reviews, and collaborative problem-solving

  • Collaborate effectively across the organization, including engineering, DevOps, product, and customer-facing teams when platform work intersects with delivery or product needs

  • Bring clarity to complex technical discussions, helping teams evaluate trade-offs, reach decisions, and move initiatives forward

  • Communicate frequently and openly with peers, sharing context, decisions, risks, and trade-offs to maintain alignment

  • Produce clear, thorough documentation for all work, proactively sharing outcomes with the platform team and impacted teams during cross-team initiatives

  • Stay engaged with platform evolution and industry best practices, continuously improving how the organization builds and operates software

  • Identify opportunities to improve engineering practices, tooling, and platform capabilities


What you’ll bring

  • 5+ years of software development experience with core platform technologies. Hands-on experience building, shipping, and maintaining production systems using Node.js, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, and TypeScript, with exposure to real-world trade-offs around scalability, reliability, and maintainability, and a solid understanding of how these technologies work together in scalable, maintainable applications.

  • Distributed systems and cloud architecture experience. Experience designing or contributing to cloud-based systems, with attention to scalability, fault tolerance, security, and operational concerns.

  • Authentication and identity fundamentals. Familiarity with modern authentication and identity concepts (e.g., OAuth2, OpenID Connect, SSO), including secure sign-in flows and how identity integrates with broader system architecture.

  • Microservices and API design experience. Experience building and maintaining service-oriented systems and well-structured APIs, with an understanding of versioning, reliability, and how services interact across distributed environments.

  • Strong software testing discipline (Unit, Integration, and End-to-End testing). A quality-first mindset with hands-on experience writing and maintaining meaningful tests, understanding where different testing strategies add value, and ensuring confidence in platform changes before release.

  • Relational database design and operation. Experience working with relational databases, including schema design, indexing, query optimization, data integrity, and reasoning about complex data models such as multi-tenant systems.

  • Strong debugging and troubleshooting. A methodical, detail-oriented approach to diagnosing issues across application code, infrastructure, and data layers, with a willingness to dig deep to identify root causes.

  • Clear documentation and communication. Ability to document technical decisions, implementations, and operational processes, and to communicate effectively with both engineering peers and cross-functional teams.

  • A growth mindset. A willingness to learn, adapt, and continuously improve technical and product skills in a fast-evolving platform environment.

  • Practical familiarity with modern AI tooling. A practical understanding of modern AI capabilities and tooling, including strengths, limitations, and appropriate use cases, with an emphasis on applying AI responsibly to enhance systems, workflows, or developer productivity.

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

 

What makes you stand out

  • Technical excellence and awareness of platform engineering best practices

  • Enjoys mentoring, sharing knowledge, and supporting the growth of other engineers

  • Passion for aviation and experience thriving in fast-paced, dynamic environments

Location

This role is based in our Vancouver office. This is an on-site role with room for flexibility, because we know life doesn't always fit a 9-to-5 mould.

 

Why Join Us

  • See Your Impact: Your contributions directly enhance the safety and efficiency of aviation operations, affecting hundreds of thousands of passengers and crew every month.

  • Build and Create: Be part of an environment where you'll have the freedom to innovate, build, and create solutions that define the future of digital aviation.

  • Growth Opportunity: Join us at an inflection point as we scale our revenue growth using cutting-edge AI tools and SaaS best practices.

  • Real Ownership: This is a small platform team with a wide remit. You'll have genuine latitude over how our foundations evolve, and see the effect of those decisions across every product we ship.

Also, we offer

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive benefits package including health and dental benefits. Paid time off plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday.

  • Invest in your future: Take advantage of our company contribution to pension/RRSP matching program to grow your savings while you work.

  • Professional Growth: As a fast-growing company, we offer incredible opportunities for career advancement and skill development.

  • Competitive salary range: We place huge importance on the contribution and experience you bring to the team. The base pay offered is based on location and may vary depending on skills, job-related knowledge, experience, and internal equity.

    For this role, the range is: $120K - $140K/year
